tool_input.description: Run scratch program to empirically observe GnuParser behavior

result:
Only the one test file I created/modified exists as expected; everything else is untouched, and the full suite (20 tests) passes cleanly.

Created `src/test/org/apache/commons/cli/GnuParserAgentTest.java` (JUnit 3.8 style, matching the project's existing tests). It covers:

- `flatten()` boundary cases directly (empty args, `"--"`, `"-"`, known/unknown short options, `--opt=value` splitting, `-Dprop=value` property-style splitting, stop-at-non-option passthrough)
- End-to-end `parse()` happy paths (short/long options, `=`-style long options, property options, double-dash, single-dash)
- Error cases: `UnrecognizedOptionException`, `MissingArgumentException`, `MissingOptionException`
- Edge cases: `null` arguments array, empty arguments array, stop-at-non-option argument accumulation

I verified the exact expected flattening/parsing behavior empirically (via a temporary scratch file outside the deliverables, now removed) before asserting on it, since GnuParser's fallback splitting logic isn't obvious from reading alone.
